title: app.yaml
description: One file per application, at <appsDir>/<name>/app.yaml in the overlay. The directory name becomes the Application name and the Helm release name. Every field is required: the ApplicationSet runs with missingkey=error.

namespace.description: Destination namespace, declared in addons/ (with its Pod Security labels).

repoURL.description: Chart repository. OCI registries are written without the oci:// scheme and must be declared in `repositories` and in the applications project's sourceRepos.

version.description: Exact chart version: no range, no latest.

autoSync.description: false for a new application: its first sync is reviewed and triggered by hand, then it is switched to true.
